pmf.note: GF1-GF5 normalised to relative source contributions via normalize_gf_fractions; raw values are PM2.5 mass fractions.

spartan_map.json.note: All sites in the local SPARTAN inventory, including sites without public PM2.5 filter chemistry. Statistics use the available public ChemSpecPM25 data over its full date range, one value per physical filter. Hollow markers have no selected measurement. EC and OC are FTIR-derived; public BC is an optical product. Sidebar season, date and exclusion choices apply to the four-focus-site views.

improve_map.json.note: Validated FED IMPROVE Aerosol, 2003-01-03–2026-02-28; downloaded 2026-10-14. Preliminary data are excluded. Counts describe dated samples with positive, available EC and absorption, rather than the full historical network or the FTIR calibration set. Measurement summaries use each field's available values. Study-site, season, date and exclusion controls do not apply to these summaries. FED's current 2021 absorption records end on 2021-05-31; later samples cannot enter the paired EC/absorption population.

aeronet/sites_summary.json.source: NASA AERONET Version 3 (aeronet.gsfc.nasa.gov): direct-sun AOD, SDA fine/coarse split, almucantar inversions
aeronet/sites_summary.json.note: Per SPARTAN site with an AERONET station: medians over its non-excluded filters of the AERONET means inside each filter's sampling window (export_aeronet.py), all year and by the site's season calendar (siteSeasons.network.json). eta = filter PM2.5 / AOD 500, for filters with both positive; H = AAOD 675 / surface Fabs. AOD is a daylight, clear-sky mean; PM2.5 covers the whole window.
